page.content:
Cameron's Colonial Marine sequel with Newt and the Queen.

How Aliens connects

  • Creator: James Cameron — James Cameron wrote and directed Aliens.
  • Topic: Alien — Aliens is the 1986 sequel that expands the hive.
  • Character: Ellen Ripley — Aliens returns Ripley to LV-426 with the Marines.
  • Work: Alien (1979) — Aliens follows Ripley after the Nostromo.
  • Character: Newt — Newt is the child survivor at the center of Aliens.
  • Character: Xenomorph Queen — Aliens introduces the Queen as the hive's mother.
  • Location: LV-426 — Aliens is fought on LV-426 around Hadley's Hope.

What is Aliens?

Aliens sends Ripley back to LV-426 with Colonial Marines, Bishop, and a hive that produces the Queen — and a child survivor named Newt.

Key threads lead to James Cameron, Alien, Ellen Ripley, Alien (1979), Newt and Xenomorph Queen.
